description: Google announced the date for The Android Show: I/O Edition on Tuesday. The second edition of the virtual-only event will take place on May 12 and will build up to the company’s developer conference later this month.  The Mountain View-based tech giant says this will be one of the biggest years for Android, but did not reveal any new features coming to Android 17.
title: Google to Host The Android Show Ahead of I/O 2026 Developer Conference Next Week

description: Using James Webb Space Telescope, astronomers directly measured heat from LHS 3844 b, revealing a dark, rocky surface with no atmosphere—more like Mercury than Earth—marking a breakthrough in studying exoplanet geology.
title: Astronomers Use Webb Telescope to Study Exoplanet Surface Beyond Atmosphere

description: Western Union has launched the USDPT stablecoin on Solana as part of its expansion into blockchain-based settlement and remittance infrastructure. The stablecoin is initially rolling out in Bolivia and the Philippines, with broader expansion planned for 2026.
title: Western Union Launches USDPT Stablecoin on Solana Blockchain, Coin Issued by Anchorage Digital

description: Oppo Find X9s is set to arrive in India soon. The company recently shared a teaser on social media, offering a glimpse of the phone’s design. It debuted in global markets last month, with a 6.59-inch display and powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9500s chipset. The global version has a 7,025mAh battery with support for 80W wired fast charging. Here is a complete look at the expected pricing, specifications, and features of the phone in India.
title: Oppo Find X9s India Launch Roundup: Expected Price in India, Specifications

description: Samsung’s Brazil website briefly mentioned the Galaxy A27. It is confirmed to be compatible with Samsung Wallet. This hints that the official launch may not be far off. The upcoming phone is said to feature a 6.7-Inch display and a triple rear camera unit featuring a 50-megapixel primary sensor, an 8-megapixel ultrawide rear camera and a 2-megapixel macro sensor. It could run on a Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset.
title: Samsung Galaxy A27 Seemingly Confirmed via Company's Website, Could Launch Soon

description: Deepinder Goyal has opened early access for Temple, a wearable designed to track physical and cognitive health. The first 100 units are ready, and applications are open through the official website. The device is worn on the temple and aims to capture more accurate physiological signals than wrist-based trackers. It focuses on tracking brain blood flow, which is linked to neurological function. Temple is based on the gravity ageing hypothesis, though the idea remains debated.
title: Temple Wearable Enters Early Access: Zomato Co-Founder Deepinder Goyal Says First 100 Units Ready to Ship

description: Bharathanatyam 2: Mohiniyattam is a Malayalam dark comedy film that is making its way to the digital screens soon. It is a blend of comedy and thriller.
title: Bharathanatyam 2: Mohiniyattam OTT Release Date Revealed: Know When and Where to Watch This Malayalam Dark Comedy Online

description: Papam Prathap is a Telugu drama film that is set to land on the digital screens soon. It has been written and directed by SP Durganaresh.
title: Papam Prathap OTT Release Date Revealed: When and Where to Watch This Telugu Drama Film

description: Thukra Ke Mera Pyaar Season 2 continues the emotional story of Kuldeep and Shanvika as love turns into revenge amid politics, betrayal, and family pressure.
title: Thukra Ke Mera Pyaar Season 2 OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Kuheli is an upcoming dark murder mystery on Hoichoi that follows DSP Agni Basu as she investigates the murder of SP Rana Singha amid secrets, strained relationships, and suspense in Darjeeling.
title: Kuheli OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch This Bengali Murder Mystery Online?

description: Honor Play 80 Plus has been launched in China as the newest member of the smartphone maker's budget Play 80 family. The handset is available for pre-order in China via the Honor online store. It is offered in Aquamarine, Floating Gold, and Inkstone Black (translated from Chinese) colour options. It sports a 6.61-inch (720 x 1,604 pixels) TFT LCD touchscreen, offering up to 120Hz of refresh rate, up to 1,010 nits peak brightness, and 16.7 million colours. A Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 chipset, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.3GHz, powers the new Honor Play 80 Plus.
title: Honor Play 80 Plus Launched With 7,500mAh Battery, 13-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Anthropic and OpenAI might soon compete for a share of the enterprise services market. On Monday, the Claude maker announced the creation of a new enterprise artificial intelligence (AI) services company to serve mid-sized businesses across sectors. The new venture brings together Anthropic, Blackstone, Hellman & Friedman, and Goldman Sachs and is backed by several investors.
title: Anthropic Announces New AI Services Company, OpenAI Reportedly Follows Suit

description: Samsung is rumoured to be developing two book-style foldable smartphones as part of its 2026 lineup. Alongside the expected Galaxy Z Fold 8, the South Korean tech giant could also introduce a wider version of its foldable, ubiquitously known as the Galaxy Z Fold Wide. While Samsung has yet to confirm its 2026 foldable lineup, a pre-release version of One UI 9 is said to include visuals of the purported Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Wide Fold, providing an early glimpse at their design.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Wide Fold Design Emerges via One UI 9 Leak

description: Xiaomi, on Monday, announced that it has achieved a major milestone in India. As per the Chinese consumer tech giant, the company (inclusive of both Xiaomi and Redmi brands) had posted a record 212 percent year-on-year (YoY) performance in the mid-premum smartphone segment during the previous three months.
title: Xiaomi Claims Record Performance in Mid-Premium Smartphone Segment in India

description: Activision has confirmed that the next Call of Duty is not being developed for PS4. Call of Duty games have been cross-gen releases, launching on PS4 and Xbox One, alongside current-gen consoles. Fans have claimed that cross-gen releases have held back Call of Duty games from making a technical leap on current-gen consoles.
title: Next Call of Duty Will Not Release on Last-Gen Consoles, Activision Confirms

description: The OnePlus Pad 4 is now available for purchase in India. The successor to the OnePlus Pad 3 was launched last month and is positioned as a flagship tablet, sitting above the OnePlus Pad Go 2 in the brand’s lineup. It sports a 13.2-inch 3.4K LCD screen with a 144Hz refresh rate. The tablet is powered by Qualcomm's flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, coupled with up to 12GB of RAM. The OnePlus Pad 4 comes with the OnePlus Stylo Pro stylus and packs a 13,380mAh battery.
title: OnePlus Pad 4 With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC, Android 16 Goes on Sale in India: Price, Specifications

description: The OnePlus Pad 4 is a confident step forward for the brand. It delivers excellent performance, a large and vibrant display, and a refined OxygenOS 16 experience that makes multitasking useful. It’s not perfect, and won’t replace a laptop for everyone, but it gets closer than most. If you’re looking for a premium Android tablet that balances work and entertainment effectively, the OnePlus Pad 4 is an easy recommendation.
title: OnePlus Pad 4 Review: Big Screen, Bigger Ambitions

description: The Asus Zenbook S14 has a premium and sleek design language. The laptop packs a 14-inch 3K OLED display that offers punchy colours. It also features a powerful Intel Core Ultra 9 386H series processor that delivers top-notch performance and provides long-lasting battery life. The device also features a decent keyboard with short key travel and a large touchpad for a smooth typing and scrolling experience.
title: Asus Zenbook S14 (UX5406) Review: Premium, Portable, and Powerful

description: Vivo V70 Lite 4G is expected to be introduced soon as the fourth addition to the Vivo V70 series. The chinese tech brand is yet to confirm its launch date, but ahead of it, the handset has been spotted on the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) website. The unannounced Vivo Y05e has also US FCC website. The listings reveal the names, model numbers and battery capacity of the phones.
title: Vivo V70 Lite 4G, Vivo Y05e Reportedly Listed on US FCC Database Along With Battery Details

description: Motorola Razr Fold will be launched in India in May, the tech firm confirmed on Tuesday. The handset will arrive in the country as the company’s first book-style foldable. While the company has yet to reveal the phone’s exact launch in India, it is confirmed to be unveiled in China on May 19. This comes soon after the foldable’s launch in the US, where it is powered by a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset, which is built on a 3nm process. Globally, the handset also carries a triple rear camera system, led by a 50-megapixel main shooter.
title: Motorola Razr Fold India Launch Teased; Set to Arrive in May as Company’s First Book-Style Foldable

description: Xiaomi’s Redmi 17 series has surfaced in a new report, revealing details about the upcoming Redmi 17 4G and related models. The phone has appeared on the FCC database with multiple RAM and storage options, along with standard connectivity features. It may use the Snapdragon 6s 4G Gen 2 chipset and could also launch as a Poco M9 4G. The report also points to Redmi 17 5G and other models powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 4, targeting multiple global markets.
title: Redmi 17 4G Listing Hints at Multiple Memory Configurations; Rebranded Poco Model Also Expected: Report

description: Xiaomi’s Smart Band 10 Pro has surfaced in a new report, revealing its design and key features. The wearable is expected to offer a larger 1.74-inch AMOLED display, aluminium build, and optional NFC support for payments. It may also deliver up to 21 days of battery life under light usage. The device is likely to retain core health tracking features while moving closer to smartwatch territory. Pricing and launch details remain unknown at this stage.
title: Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro Spotted in New Leak With Rectangular AMOLED Display, NFC Support

description: FCC reportedly voted unanimously to ​advance a proposal to bar all Chinese labs from testing electronic ‌devices meant to be used in the US. About 75 percent of all US electronics are tested in China, and the agency wants to adopt a new approval process for devices tested in US labs or labs from other ​countries that are not seen as security risks. Further, the FCC voted to move forward with a plan to ban companies like China Mobile, China Telecom, and China Unicom from running data centres in the US.
title: US FCC Reportedly Moves to Bar Chinese Labs From Certifying US-Bound Devices Including Smartphones, Laptops

description: B by Lenskart smart glasses’ early access registrations are now open in India, the eyewear company revealed on Tuesday. The new smart glasses by the company were first introduced in November last year and were expected to be launched in the country in the following month. The new smart glasses by the Peyush Bansal-led eyewear company will be offered in Black and Silver colour options. The wearable will be powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1 SoC, along with 32GB of onboard storage. Moreover, it will feature Google’s Gemini AI voice assistant to answer queries.
title: B by Lenskart Smart Glasses Price in India, Key Specifications Revealed as Early Access Registrations Open

description: Bitcoin traded near $80,900 on Tuesday as ETF inflows and improving investor sentiment supported the crypto market. Analysts said easing geopolitical tensions and continued institutional demand helped BTC maintain strength above key support levels.
title: Crypto Market Recovery Continues as Bitcoin's Price Settles Above $80,000 Mark

description: Samsung has discontinued two of its LPDDR4 series memory chips as it shifts focus towards newer and faster alternatives. In recent weeks, reports emerged that the South Korean tech conglomerate could cease manufacturing of the LPDDR4 and LPDDR4x RAM by the end of 2026, potentially resulting in all Samsung phones moving entirely to the LPDDR5 lineup. The move comes at a time when global demand for high-performance memory is rising sharply, driven by AI workloads and data centre expansion.
title: Samsung Officially Discontinues LPDDR4, LPDDR4x RAM Amid Surging Demand for AI Workloads

description: Ming-Chi Kuo offered details about OpenAI's first AI phone. The company is said to be fast-tracking its first AI agent phone, with mass production set to start as early as the first half of next year. It is said to run on a customised version of the MediaTek Dimensity 9600 chipset, manufactured using TSMC's N2P node. The chipset could feature an image signal processor (ISP) featuring an upgraded HDR pipeline.
title: OpenAI Accelerates AI Phone Development With Advanced MediaTek Processor: Ming-Chi Kuo

description: World Liberty Financial has filed a defamation lawsuit against Tron founder Justin Sun in Florida, accusing him of making false public claims and violating WLFI token sale terms. Sun has denied the allegations and called the case a publicity stunt.
title: World Liberty Financial Sues Tron Founder Justin Sun for Defamation

description: Apple is in early talks with Intel, the US-based tech giant, to offer a chip manufacturing contract to the company for future Apple SoCs, according to a report citing people with knowledge of the matter. On top of this, executives of the Cupertino company have reportedly visited the new Samsung facility in Texas, which is currently under construction, and which could manufacture “advanced chips” for the Tim Cook-led firm. This is said to allow the company to shift its chip manufacturing to the US, reducing its dependence on Taiwan-based TSMC.
title: Apple Said to Be in Talks With Intel and Samsung to Produce Its Chips in the US

description: Samsung has unveiled a range of next-generation display technologies at Display Week 2026. The lineup includes a wide colour gamut OLED reaching 3,000 nits and covering 96 percent of BT.2020, a 500 PPI Sensor OLED Display with biometric tracking, and improved EL-QD panels with higher brightness. The company also showcased a stretchable micro-LED display designed for automotive use. These developments highlight advancements in brightness, colour accuracy, and new use cases across smartphones and vehicles.
title: Samsung Showcases 3000-Nit Wide Colour Gamut OLED, Next-Gen 500-Nit EL-QD Display and More at Display Week 2026

description: Flipkart has started teasing its upcoming sale on the website. The Flipkart Summer Sale is confirmed to start on May 9 and will offer a wide range of products with lucrative discounts. During the sale period, consumers can find smartphones, tablets, laptops, smartwatches, earphones, home appliances, and more.
title: Flipkart Summer Sale 2026: Best Deals on Tablets From Apple, Samsung, and More

description: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ will be launched in India soon with significant upgrades over the Edge 70 Pro model, a tipster claims. These upgrades will reportedly fill the “gaps” in the existing Edge 70 Pro, which was launched in India on April 22. The handset is said to boast a telephoto camera on the back, unlike the Motorola Edge 70 Pro, which features primary and ultrawide cameras. Moreover, the rumoured Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ will reportedly support wireless charging. The top-of-the-line model is said to feature 16GB of RAM. Additionally, it could be offered in three colour options, too.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ Tipped to Launch in India Soon With Three Upgrades Over Motorola Edge 70 Pro

description: iQOO Neo 10’s new colour variants are now available for purchase in India. Introduced last month, the Alpine White and Asphalt black colourways join the existing Inferno Red and Titanium Chrome finishes, which originally debuted in 2025. It is, however, just a cosmetic refresh, while the handset’s core specifications remain identical. The iQOO Neo 10 is powered by the Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset, coupled with up to 12GB of RAM. It packs a 7,000mAh battery.
title: iQOO Neo 10 Alpine White, Asphalt Black Variants Go on Sale in India: Price, Specifications

description: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has talked about why Rockstar Games is not releasing GTA 6 on PC on day one. The Take-Two boss said consoles were Rockstar's "core" audience. "“Rockstar always starts on console because I think with regard to a release like that you're judged by serving the core,” he said.
title: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick Explains Why GTA 6 Isn't Coming to PC, Says Console Is 'Core' Audience

description: iPhone 17 series took the first three spots in becoming the best-selling smartphones globally in the first quarter (Q1) of 2026, according to the latest Counterpoint Research report. Leading the pack was the standard iPhone 17 model, commanding a 6 percent market share of all the handsets sold globally in the quarter. Following the standard model were the iPhone 17 Pro Max and the iPhone 17 Pro models, occupying second and third positions, respectively. Out of the top 10 best-selling smartphones globally, four handsets were from Apple.
title: iPhone 17 Was Best-Selling Handset Globally in Q1 2026, Samsung Galaxy A07 4G Ranked Top Android Phone: Counterpoint

description: Samsung and Huawei are said to be testing 200-megapixel main rear cameras with variable apertures. The Galaxy S27 Ultra, which is likely to launch early next year, will likely include this feature. Variable aperture offers improvements over the fixed apertures available in current Galaxy S series smartphones. Samsung implemented the variable aperture technology in the Galaxy S9 in 2018. Apple could also use this in its upcoming iPhone 18 Pro series.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Tipped to Feature 200-Megapixel Camera With Variable Aperture to Rival iPhone 18 Pro Max

description: Google’s upcoming Pixel 11 series has leaked in detail, revealing key hardware upgrades and design changes. The lineup, including Pixel 11, Pro, Pro XL, and Pro Fold, is expected to use a new 2nm Tensor G6 chip with updated CPU, GPU, and modem. Displays may get brighter, and new camera sensors could improve imaging performance. The Pro models may drop the temperature sensor in favour of an RGB LED system called Pixel Glow. However, the rumoured IR face unlock feature may not arrive this year.
title: Google Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, XL and Pixel Fold Leak Hints at Tensor G6, New Cameras, Pixel Glow Design

description: The OnePlus Summer Sale has been announced in India. It brings a range of discounts across OnePlus-branded smartphones, tablets, and audio products. The sale will go live on May 8 at 12am IST. Customers will be able to avail of discounts, bank offers, and no-cost EMI options on products across OnePlus’ official website, Experience Stores, and Amazon, with tablets also available on Flipkart. The company says audio products will be sold across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Blinkit, and other retail channels.
title: OnePlus Summer Sale: Deals on OnePlus 15, OnePlus 13, OnePlus Pad 4 and More Announced

description: The Xiaomi 17T and Xiaomi 17T Pro have been rumoured to be in development as the successor to last year’s 15T models. Both handsets have been subject to a number of leaks in the past few weeks. A recent report has revealed detailed images of the Xiaomi 17T and 17T Pro. The standard and the Pro model appear to differ in terms of dimensions, while their overall design and colourways could be identical.
title: Xiaomi 17T, Xiaomi 17T Pro Leaked Images Reportedly Reveal Design and Colour Options
